It registers the eight widgets and matches `HRL_LEARN.mount(name, container, opts, onComplete)`. I could not run `node --check` (no shell this turn).

---

### 1. Registry API and `ctx`

```js
HRL_INTERACTIVE = {
  widgets: { /* name -> { mount: function (container, opts, onComplete, ctx) {} } */ },
  register: function (name, def),     // def is { mount: fn } or a bare mount function
  has: function (name),               // true if a mount function is registered
  names: function (),                 // sorted registered names
  mount: function (name, container, opts, onComplete)
};
```

`mount(name, container, opts, onComplete)`:
- Returns `false` and renders `.empty-state` when the name is unknown (does not throw).
- Clears `container` before mounting.
- Passes a `ctx` helper as the **fourth** argument to the widget `mount`.
- Guards a missing `onComplete`. Completion is `{ completed: true, correct: n, total: m }`.

`ctx` methods:

| Method | Signature |
|---|---|
| `el` | `function (tag, attrs, children)` |
| `esc` | `function (s)` → HTML-escaped string |
| `shuffle` | `function (arr)` → new shuffled copy |
| `status` | `function (container, message, kind)` → `.widget-status` with `aria-live="polite"` |
| `actions` | `function (container, buttons)` → `.widget-actions`; each button is `{ label, onClick, kind, primary, disabled }` |
| `reducedMotion` | `function ()` → boolean (OS preference, `body.reduced-motion`, or `HRL_PROGRESS.getSetting('reducedMotion')`) |

Shared helper used by MCQ widgets: `choiceIsCorrect(answer, choices, picked)` — numeric `answer` is an index into `choices`; string `answer` matches choice text. Prompt text prefers `question`, then `prompt`, then `text`.

---

### 2. The eight widgets

**`labelTheField`**
- Reads: `items` or `parts` (`id`, `label`, optional `hint`); optional `diagram.svg` / `diagram.opts`.
- Missing/empty items → `.empty-state` (“No field parts were provided…”).
- Keyboard: Tab to a `.token`, Enter/Space to pick up; Tab to a hotspot or overlay `.dropzone`, Enter/Space to place. Check / Reset / Show me are buttons.

**`placeThePositions`**
- Reads: `items` (`id`, `number`, `name`, `hint`); optional `mode` (`all`/`infield`/`outfield`), `positions` id list, `diagram`.
- Missing items and no synthesizable positions → `.empty-state`.
- Tokens show number + abbreviation (`1 P`). Drop on a hotspot snaps to the nearest valid spot.
- Keyboard: same pick-up / place path as label-the-field.

**`strikeZoneTrainer`**
- Reads: `mode` (`ball-strike` default, `swing-decision` supported), `cases` (`x`, `y`, `call` / `decision` / `answer`, `explain`, optional `count`).
- Empty `cases` → `.empty-state`.
- Keyboard: Tab to Ball/Strike (or Swing/Take), Enter/Space to select, Tab to Check.

**`countBuilder`**
- Reads: `steps` (fallback `cases`) with `pitch`, `result`, `note`; or `{ freeplay: true }`.
- Neither steps nor freeplay → `.empty-state`.
- Guided: select Ball / Strike / Foul / In play, then Check. Free play applies immediately and narrates (including foul-with-two-strikes). Uses `HRL_SVG.countMatrix` with `highlight`.
- Keyboard: those four buttons plus Check / Reset.

**`safeOrOut`**
- Reads: `mode` (`safe-out`, `run-scored`, `game-state`), `cases` (`prompt`/`text`, `answer`, `explain`, optional `choices`).
- Empty `cases` → `.empty-state`.
- Buckets: Safe/Out; Run scores/No run; or the case’s own two `choices`.
- Keyboard: focus the card, Left/Right to pick a bucket, Enter/Space to Check; or Tab to the two bucket buttons.

**`runnerAdvance`**
- Reads: `cases` (`text`/`prompt`, `start`, `hit`, `correct`, `explain`).
- Empty `cases` → `.empty-state`.
- Click a runner token, then a base hotspot or the Out dropzone. After Check, arrows animate unless `ctx.reducedMotion()`.
- Keyboard: Tab tokens and dest buttons, Enter/Space to pick/place; SVG hotspots also take Enter/Space.

**`swingOrder`**
- Reads: `frames`, `cues`, and/or `items` (`id`, `label`, `cue`).
- Fewer than two frames → `.empty-state`.
- Each slot has Move left / Move right. Drag-to-swap as well. Check reveals canonical order plus cues.
- Keyboard: Tab to move buttons, or focus a frame token and use Left/Right arrows.

**`armCareCheck`**
- Reads: `cases` (`question`/`prompt`, `choices`, `answer` as string or index, `explain`, `source`, plus `age` / `division` / `pitches` / `daysRest` as facts).
- Empty `cases` → `.empty-state`.
- **No pitch-count tables in this file** — answers and explanations come from the case.
- Keyboard: Tab to choice buttons, Enter/Space to select, Tab to Check.

Every widget has Check, Reset, and an `aria-live="polite"` `.widget-status`. Two failed Checks reveal the answer. Mouse, tap-to-place, and keyboard all work; drag is extra, not the only path.

---

### 3. CSS classes not already in `styles.css`

**None.** Emitted classes are only:

`.empty-state`, `.hint`, `.token`, `.selected`, `.placed`, `.dropzone`, `.over`, `.correct`, `.wrong`, `.btn`, `.btn-sm`, `.btn-primary`, `.btn-accent`, `.btn-ghost`, `.widget-status`, `.widget-actions`, `.progress-bar`, `.progress-bar-fill`.

Layout glue (token trays, diagram overlay host) uses inline flex/position styles so no new stylesheet was required.

---

### 4. Where curriculum `opts` differed — and what I did

Curriculum shapes win.

| Widget | Brief guessed | Curriculum actually passes | Handling |
|---|---|---|---|
| `labelTheField` | `parts` + `diagram` | `items: [{ id, label }]` only | Accept `items` or `parts`; build a `field` SVG with those hotspot ids if `diagram` is absent |
| `placeThePositions` | `positions` ids + `mode` + `diagram` | ch03: `items` only; ch11: `mode`, `positions`, `diagram`, `items` | All of the above; synthesize from ids if `items` is missing |
| `strikeZoneTrainer` | also `swing-decision` | only `mode: 'ball-strike'` | Default ball-strike; still handle swing-decision |
| `countBuilder` | `steps` **or** `freeplay` | **both** `steps` and `cases` (same seven pitches) | Prefer `steps`, fall back to `cases`; `freeplay` still supported |
| `safeOrOut` | two buckets; `text` | `prompt` + `answer: 'yes'/'no'/'safe'/'out'` | `casePrompt()` fallback; string answers mapped to bucket ids |
| `runnerAdvance` | `text`, `start`, `hit`, `correct` | both `text` and `prompt`; `correct.batter` etc. can be `null` | Prefer prompt; only the batter plus occupied bases are placed |
| `swingOrder` | `frames` + `cues` | also `items: [{ id, label, cue }]` | Union of all three |
| `armCareCheck` | calculator against hardcoded limits | MCQ: `choices` + string `answer` + `source` | Quiz against case data only |

`answer` as string **or** index is handled in one helper. Extra case fields (`id`, `source`, `diagram`) are ignored unless needed.

---

### 5. Deviations from the brief

- Widgets do **not** wrap another `.widget` / `.widget-head`. `learn.js` already does that; this file fills `.widget-mount` with the stage, `.widget-status`, and `.widget-actions`.
- `ctx` is the fourth `mount` argument (`container, opts, onComplete, ctx`), because the documented three-arg signature has no slot for it. Widgets inside this file use that `ctx`.
- “Card flip” on `safeOrOut` is an explanation reveal, not a 3D CSS flip (and motion is skipped under reduced motion anyway).
- `Show me` is on both placement widgets (shared helper), not only `labelTheField`.
- The other eight curriculum widgets (`assignTheNine`, `makeTheCall`, …) are **not** in this chunk.
- No syntax/runtime verification this turn (shell is forbidden). The reviewer should run `node --check interactive.js`.
